name: XashPS5
description: Native PS5 port of Xash3D FWGS: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift up to 4K at 60 FPS with DualSense input. Needs your own Half-Life game data.
author: GordonProsperoMan
release_notes:
New
- Vulkan rendering: the game now runs on Mesa Zink over the RADV Vulkan driver (PS5_Vulkan by Mihawk). Whole frames go to the GPU at once: steady frame rate in 4K even in the heaviest fights.
- 4K by default. 1440p and 1080p are still available in Options, Video, Video modes.
- 120 FPS on 120 Hz displays: open Options, Video, Video modes and tick 120 Hz. It is off by default. The console must also allow 120 Hz output (Settings, Screen and Video, Video Output).
- Counter-Strike (your own cstrike folder): game code and menus built in, with team selection, buy menu (D-pad up), MOTD and a Change team button in the pause menu.
- USB keyboard and mouse (or a wireless USB receiver): keys by position, mouse look, buttons and wheel, a cursor in the menus. QWERTY text by default, type ps5_kb_layout fr in the console for AZERTY. The DualSense keeps working at the same time.
- Toggle crouch on Circle, with a checkbox in Options, Gamepad (on by default).
- New right-stick aim curve: one circular deadzone and a response curve, precise small moves and fast full turns. Idea and tuning from mpereiraesaa/ps5-xash3d-halflife, thank you.
- A notification tells you what to copy when the game files are missing.

Fixes
- The PS5 system keyboard could stay disabled after using an older build.
- No more crash when a file inside a .pk3 archive is opened.

Changed
- Quieter logs. Create /data/xash_debug.txt on the console for verbose output.
- The previous run's log is kept as /data/xash_log_previous.txt.

Install
- Download PPSA19111.zip and unzip it.
- Copy your own valve folder into PPSA19111/valve/, plus gearbox, bshift and/or cstrike if you own them (delete the folders you don't use). Keep the .cfg files and valve/extras.pk3 from the zip.
- Counter-Strike also needs extras.pk3 in PPSA19111/cstrike/: take it from the cstrike folder of CS16Client-Linux-x86_64.tar.gz in the releases of Velaron/cs16-client. It isn't included here because it contains game sounds and maps.
- Send PPSA19111/ to /data/homebrew/ over FTP (etaHEN, port 2121), or install it from the homebrew store.
- Launch XashPS5 V1.3 from the home screen. The first launch takes a little longer while shaders are prepared.

Upgrading from 1.2: same title PPSA19111, your saves and settings are kept. If an update replaces the app folder, copy your game folders back into it.

No game data is included. You need your own Half-Life files.

Known limitations
- Counter-Strike bots are not included yet.
- Internet server browser works; LAN works.
- Accented characters can't be typed from a USB keyboard yet.

Thanks
Mihawk (PS5_Vulkan, PS5_Mesa, PS5_PayloadSDK), BlackBearReloaded (ps5-opengl, ps5-native-app-boilerplate, ProsperoTV, keyboard and mouse research), Velaron (cs16-client) and the ReGameDLL_CS team, mpereiraesaa (ps5-xash3d-halflife), FWGS (Xash3D FWGS, hlsdk-portable).

Assets
- PPSA19111.zip: eboot.bin, sce_module/libc.prx, sce_sys/, valve/ (userconfig.cfg, autoexec.cfg, extras.pk3), gearbox/, bshift/ and cstrike/ (userconfig.cfg), install notes
- PPSA19111.zip.sha256
